_meta.notes: Comprehensive index of all thematic clusters (Level 4) and sub-clusters (Level 5) for Fiji.

910.name: Lapita Settlement of Fiji
910.description: Lapita pottery-makers arrive from island Southeast Asia; earliest settlement of Fiji.

sub_clusters.name: Lapita Peoples Arrive
sub_clusters.description: Austronesian navigators colonise Fiji; Sigatoka sand dune sites; pottery traditions.

sub_clusters.name: Transition to Melanesian Culture
sub_clusters.description: Cultural divergence from Polynesian cousins; development of distinctly Fijian traditions.

920.name: Pre-Contact Fijian Chiefdoms
920.description: Development of complex chiefdoms, warfare, cannibalism, inter-island trade.

sub_clusters.name: Fijian Chiefdom System
sub_clusters.description: Hierarchical chiefly society; yavusa, mataqali, vanua social structure.

sub_clusters.name: Tongan Influence in Eastern Fiji
sub_clusters.description: Tongan Tu'i Tonga empire influence on Lau Islands; cultural exchange.

sub_clusters.name: Fortified Ring-Ditch Villages
sub_clusters.description: Defensive earthworks, palisades; inter-tribal warfare intensification.

930.name: European Contact Period
930.description: Dutch sighting, Cook observations, traders and beachcombers arrive.

sub_clusters.name: Tasman's Sighting of Fiji
sub_clusters.description: Abel Tasman sails past northern Fiji; first European record.

sub_clusters.name: Sandalwood Trade
sub_clusters.description: European and American traders harvest sandalwood; first sustained contact.

sub_clusters.name: Beachcombers and Castaways
sub_clusters.description: Shipwrecked sailors, escaped convicts live among Fijians; cultural intermediaries.

940.name: Cakobau and Fijian Unification
940.description: Ratu Seru Epenisa Cakobau attempts to unify Fiji; missionary era; cession to Britain.

sub_clusters.name: Rise of Cakobau
sub_clusters.description: Bau Island chief consolidates power; accepts Christianity 1854.

sub_clusters.name: Methodist Missions
sub_clusters.description: Conversion campaigns; end of cannibalism; literacy spread.

sub_clusters.name: Cession to Britain
sub_clusters.description: Cakobau cedes Fiji to Queen Victoria; British Crown Colony established.

940.name: British Colonial Period
940.description: Governor Gordon's policies; indentured Indian labour; sugar economy.

sub_clusters.name: Gordon's Native Policy
sub_clusters.description: Protectionist policies; communal land tenure preserved; Great Council of Chiefs.

sub_clusters.name: Indian Indenture System (Girmit)
sub_clusters.description: 60,000+ Indian labourers brought to work sugar plantations; foundation of Indo-Fijian community.

sub_clusters.name: Sugar Economy
sub_clusters.description: CSR Company dominates; plantation economy shapes demographics and politics.

950.name: Fiji in World War II
950.description: Fijian soldiers serve in Solomon Islands campaign; home front changes.

sub_clusters.name: Fiji Military Forces in WWII
sub_clusters.description: Fijian commandos in Solomon Islands; Bougainville; Allied base.

950.name: Road to Independence
950.description: Constitutional conferences; ethnic power-sharing debates; independence achieved.

sub_clusters.name: Constitutional Conferences
sub_clusters.description: Fijian-Indian representation negotiations; communal roll system.

sub_clusters.name: Fiji Independence (1970)
sub_clusters.description: Independence from Britain; Ratu Sir Kamisese Mara first Prime Minister.

960.name: Fiji Coups Era
960.description: Four military coups destabilise democracy; ethnic tensions; constitutional crises.

sub_clusters.name: Rabuka Coups (1987)
sub_clusters.description: Two coups by Lt Col Rabuka; republic declared; Indian emigration wave.

sub_clusters.name: Speight Coup (2000)
sub_clusters.description: George Speight hostage crisis; Chaudhry government overthrown.

sub_clusters.name: Bainimarama Coup (2006)
sub_clusters.description: Military commander overthrows Qarase government; rules until 2014 elections.

960.name: Contemporary Fiji
960.description: Return to democracy; climate change leadership; rugby and tourism.

sub_clusters.name: Return to Democracy
sub_clusters.description: 2013 Constitution; 2014 elections; Bainimarama elected PM democratically.

sub_clusters.name: Climate Change Advocacy
sub_clusters.description: COP23 presidency; Pacific Island leadership on climate; rising sea levels threat.
